needs: an arena region with alloc_slice for a DP table
parsing a pattern into tokens by index
pitfalls: ? and [..] must count a code point, not a byte (? vs the two-byte e-acute)
* stops at / but ** does not, and a/**/b needs both slashes (no a/b)
no set matches / even when negated, but a literal / or escaped slash does
[]] and [!] are EMPTY sets (first ] closes), so invalid; ']' cannot be put in a set
a reversed range invalidates the pattern even when the range is never reached by the text
a trailing single backslash is invalid; backslash is plain inside a set
exponential backtracking on a*a*a*a*b against a run of a (needs a table/DP, not recursion)
an invalid pattern must match nothing, including the empty text with pattern [
DP offsets must advance by character width and never land mid-character
a first/last - in a set is plain; x-y needs a char on both sides of the dash
difficulty_notes: Hard item. Seven units; the match unit is the hard one (token walk + region table, with the plan's description naming the technique). The oracle is the lex-code regex-based Python (vendored unchanged), cross-checked here against an independent DP matcher on 200000 random patterns/texts with 0 differences. The audit grades glob_match (64) and glob_valid (23) only; the helper units (glob_cp_at, glob_cp_len, glob_set_has, glob_tok_end, glob_one) are plan scaffolding, tested by the plan's own tests, not by the audit. Oracle gaps: no invalid-UTF-8 inputs, no ambiguous '--' range bodies like [--z].
